stem.text: Two spheres approach each other along the same straight line. Their speeds are $u_1$ and $u_2$ before they collide. After the collision, the spheres separate with speeds $v_1$ and $v_2$ in the directions shown below.

stem.alt: Two circles (spheres) side by side, each with a horizontal velocity arrow above it: the left arrow labelled u1 points right and the right arrow labelled u2 points left. Labelled before collision.
Two circles (spheres) side by side, each with a horizontal velocity arrow above it pointing right: the left arrow labelled v1 and the right arrow labelled v2. Labelled after collision.

stem.text: The collision is perfectly elastic. Which equation must be correct?
